Revision

This is the sixth working file: guidance for revision. Keep philosophy, personal understanding, and actual work connected as they change. The maintained set has six files: the five situated accounts—orientation, person, counterpart, relationship, and environment—and this revision guide. The accounts articulate the participants, direction, and conditions; the guide explains their revision and is itself revised through use. Maintain the six together according to these different duties. The public guide contains reusable method. Actual accounts and supporting personal material remain with their private owners.

A refresh can begin with developed philosophy, changed life circumstances, an objection during work, or a result that fails to fit. Recover the intended result and current evidence, then carry the affected connections through their owners. When the request is a whole-environment refresh, use the three connected passes below. A local repair can enter at the relevant point and follow the dependencies it reveals. Neither case requires a new lifecycle, scheduler, or complete rewrite whenever one sentence changes.

Scope and connected changes

First identify the result being sought and the part that presently fails or needs development. Distinguish that revision focus from the material used to judge it and from other parts that actually need to change. Reading a philosophy or personal account as evidence does not by itself select it for rewriting. Work from the complete current six-file understanding already available under the entrypoint's reading contract; the scope of an edit follows the request and the dependencies found in the work.

Current focus Corresponding work
Refresh the whole personal Yinyang and environment Reconcile personal support with philosophy and current sources, assess all six files together, then inspect the requested Skills and environment. Change what no longer fits.
Revise a philosophical claim or personal interpretation Develop that passage and check which accounts, methods, or representations actually depend on its meaning. Carry those changes together while retaining unaffected material.
Repair a particular Skill, page, tool, or arrangement Use the relevant understanding to diagnose and fix that object. Return a mistaken premise or personal interpretation to its owner if the result exposes one.

Follow a substantive changed meaning through its actual dependents. A wording, link, or presentation correction can instead finish at its affected source and reader. Neither a whole-environment refresh nor a local repair requires changes everywhere: a change earns its scope through what the intended result needs. Conversely, stopping at the first edited file is insufficient when a required dependency still presents the old behavior. Retain any explicit user stopping boundary and carry the compatible authorized work to its stated result.

Establish the current material

Read the current philosophy and all six files, then select the personal support needed for the question. Locate maintained originals and distinguish them from summaries, generated copies, and publication snapshots. A source locator makes material discoverable; reading its current content establishes what is actually available. Keep consequential access gaps visible.

Current purposes, study or research directions, relationships, and working conditions may have changed since a retained account was written. Compare their relevant sources and actual exchange rather than preserving a summary because it already exists or inventing an update because it seems plausible. The model carries retrieval, comparison, and grounded writing; the person contributes experience and consequential judgments unavailable in the material. Reuse what they have already supplied.

Write for the actual use

Write the five accounts under references/situated/, maintain the common references/revision-guide.md, and keep derived support under references/personal/ as explicit model-facing context and instructions. State the relevant objects, relations, evidence, conditions, responsibilities, and consequences in clear natural language. Distinguish a reported experience, an interpretation, a chosen commitment, and a requirement where they would lead to different judgments or actions. Form means making these relationships usable for reasoning and work; it requires neither a fixed template nor symbolic notation. Personal information remains contextual evidence rather than becoming a command merely because a model reads it.

Use direct expression first. Bring in a philosophical distinction or literary image when it clarifies a consequential relation that the direct account does not yet make intelligible. State its relevant meaning and scope; the counterpart should not have to infer practical requirements from a character or metaphor. Preserve original expression as attributed source material, while writing the maintained interpretation and operational consequences explicitly. Keep developed philosophical arguments at their reader-facing owners and refer to them as needed.

Sources and evidence

Evidence grounds the six files; its private index is supporting material with its own duty. Maintain that entrance at references/personal/sources.md, locating the grounds of the accounts and relevant revision judgments with enough explanation to know why to look. Public distribution supplies this method, not a personal source index. Retrieve supporting evidence when the question needs it. Keep useful topical material in the private tree or with its existing owners.

Select attributable expression, personal writing, conversations, memory, observed work, and philosophy because they bear on current understanding. Retain source identity, time, the relevant passage or message, and enough context to assess consequential claims. A trace records selected activity; an interpretation explains its meaning. Where a maintained summary stands between an original and an account, make that relation clear: its selection and omissions can affect a disputed reading.

A person's report supports what they expressed or experienced in context, without establishing every explanation offered with it. Observed work shows what happened under inspected conditions while motive may remain unknown. A chosen commitment states how work should proceed; behavior shows its realization. Philosophy supplies concepts, reasons, possible interpretations, and adopted direction without proving a personal mechanism. For a fictional example, reporting that a reading arrangement feels easier supports experienced ease; a record of reaching the passage supports access. Neither establishes lasting learning or which interface change caused improvement. Later participation on a new case can supply evidence at that larger scale. Several accounts repeating one summary add no independent support.

Date changing conditions at the scale that matters: a tool available last month, a temporary workload, and a continuing commitment have different scopes. Later speech may correct an interpretation, describe a new situation, or add unresolved conflict; recency alone does not decide which. Retain conflicting evidence rather than smoothing it into a consistent portrait. Make consequential inferences traceable in prose: what suggests the interpretation, why, and which uncertainty limits its use. Reachability does not establish correspondence; an inaccessible source leaves a coverage limit.

Keep extended episodes, precise excerpts, and unique originals at their actual owners. Maintaining the accounts together does not require copying raw sources. Derived private notes state source, scope, interpretation, and relevant consequence under the writing method. Their filenames follow actual material; no empty companion is needed for each essay. Public philosophical references stay near their arguments. Preserve useful originals and recoverability while retiring redundant active material. Source maintenance authorizes neither unrelated biographical collection nor publication of private paths, quotations, portraits, or unreleased works. Return only authorized reusable insights to the public package.

Let philosophy revise personal support material

First bring the developed philosophy into contact with the existing personal material. Ask which interpretations it clarifies, which distinctions were missing, and which summaries have become misleading. Rewrite the derived accounts so relevant experience, interpretation, chosen direction, and uncertainty remain intelligible. Philosophy can help formulate an account; attributable expression and actual use ground its personal application.

Use the source distinctions above when grounds change, access fails, or a correction changes interpretation. Retire stale summaries, duplicated explanations, and public essays copied into private support when their current common owner supplies them. Retain genuinely private meaning and useful evidence rather than a second library of public theory.

Let philosophy and personal material revise the six files

Read philosophy together with the refreshed personal evidence to revise the five accounts. Read each affected account's complete formation guide before writing. Orientation states adopted values and direction; person grounds understanding of the actual person; counterpart relates available capacity to wanted contribution; relationship explains joint activity; environment explains how it becomes possible under actual conditions. These connected duties keep the five from becoming repeated versions of one portrait.

Distill the relations needed for use, with enough reasons and evidence to make them revisable. Distinguish a preference from an explanatory hypothesis, a wanted role from demonstrated capability, and a chosen arrangement from its observed effect. Both participants can generate, reason, object, and revise. Changing a division of work does not establish incapacity; improving a text does not establish personal development. Preserve supported substance, rewrite the relation that changed, and read the accounts together for coherence. Leave extended evidence at its supporting owner.

Then revise this sixth file where actual use has exposed a missing connection, an obsolete direction, or a better way to carry revision through the environment. Check that its method still serves the philosophy and grounded accounts, and that those accounts can actually be maintained through it. A full refresh therefore assesses all six files; each needs a change only where its own meaning or contribution changes.

Let the whole Yinyang revise Skills and the environment

Use the whole Yinyang, including the six maintained files and especially the five grounded accounts, to assess all Skills within the requested environment scope. Examine whether each relevant Skill's purpose, instructions, examples, resources, and actual behavior support the intended contribution. Specialist Skills retain their methods and authority; the personal accounts inform their use without being copied into every package. Assess the connected prompts, tools, and arrangements where their dependencies affect the result.

Change actual mismatches: an obsolete division of responsibility, contradictory instructions, inaccessible context, an unhelpful interface, or machinery that no longer serves a current consumer. Remove displaced guidance instead of adding another layer around it. An assessment can find that a Skill already fits and needs no edit. Coverage of the requested scope matters more than producing a cosmetic diff in every file. The environment writing guide develops realization; use the environment's actual authoring, implementation, and publication methods for realization.

Make webpage revisions visible before publication

For webpage changes, show changed diagrams directly in the conversation. For a new page or substantial page revision, show a readable rendered preview of the actual unpublished version and explain its consequential changes before publishing it. Identify which version the preview represents. If subsequent edits materially change it, show the updated preview before publishing that version. A source excerpt, proposed layout, or previously published page does not establish what the current unpublished version looks like.

This is presentation sequencing, not an approval or waiting gate. Continue already-authorized publication and verification without asking for permission or waiting for a reply. Incorporate feedback if it arrives during the work. Actual authorization, personal authentication, consent, and explicit stopping boundaries keep their existing scope.

Follow the result back into understanding

Check sources and results independently where correspondence matters: compare a summary with its evidence, a generated projection with its owner, and a completion claim with the result reached through the real entrypoint. Repeating the same interpretation across several files supplies little new evidence. An unavailable account calls for delivery repair; a faithfully followed account that produces an unsuitable contribution calls for examining its meaning or the chosen relationship.

Carry authorized changes through their actual source owners, affected consumers, and publication routes. Regenerate dependent copies, retire displaced active material, and read back the version available to the intended consumer. Keep private records, quotations, portraits, and unpublished work out of public projections. The package guide owns common/private projection; this guide creates no additional synchronization mechanism.

Compare the intended result with the observable outcome and explain any required difference still open. Let use return to personal material, any of the six files, or philosophy when evidence challenges them. A completed work can finish while the arrangement remains revisable; useful output, collaborative fit, and the person's development retain their distinct evidence.
